declared difference (issue #1035 cache-nofinger): the rc/ directory is looked for from the servlet's own directory
upward (rc/ or src/rc/), so a source root holding src/com/... and src/rc/... finds it; a servlet with no rc/
above it, and a file with no max-age>0 line, are judged exactly as before.
-- args --
@DIR@/m

exit 0

-- stderr --
-- m/src/com/x/BDash.java --

  void doGet(WebOp op) {
    rsp.setHeader("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=3600");
  }
}
